cases.name: core-types-transactions
statements: CREATE TABLE sample(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, n INTEGER, r REAL, t TEXT, b BLOB, missing)
INSERT INTO sample VALUES(1, -9223372036854775807, 3.25, 'hello', x'0001FEFF', NULL)
INSERT INTO sample VALUES(2, 42, -0.5, 'a' || char(0) || 'z', x'', NULL)
SELECT id,n,r,t,b,missing FROM sample ORDER BY id
BEGIN
UPDATE sample SET n=43 WHERE id=2
SAVEPOINT inner_save
DELETE FROM sample WHERE id=1
ROLLBACK TO inner_save
RELEASE inner_save
COMMIT
SELECT count(*),sum(id),max(n),length(b) FROM sample WHERE id=2
CREATE INDEX sample_n ON sample(n)
SELECT a.id,b.n FROM sample AS a JOIN sample AS b ON a.id=b.id ORDER BY a.id

cases.name: json-jsonb
statements: SELECT json_extract('{"a":[1,2],"n":null}', '$.a[1]'),json_type('{"n":null}', '$.n')
SELECT json_set('{"a":1}', '$.b', 2),json(jsonb('{"a":[1,2]}'))
SELECT key,value,type FROM json_each('{"a":1,"b":null}') ORDER BY key
SELECT json_valid('{broken'),json_valid('{"ok":true}')

cases.name: fts3-fts4-fts5
statements: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE search3 USING fts3(content)
INSERT INTO search3(rowid,content) VALUES(1,'small sqlite engine'),(2,'other document')
SELECT rowid,content FROM search3 WHERE search3 MATCH 'sqlite' ORDER BY rowid
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE search4 USING fts4(content)
INSERT INTO search4(rowid,content) VALUES(1,'full text sqlite'),(2,'other document')
SELECT rowid,content FROM search4 WHERE search4 MATCH 'sqlite' ORDER BY rowid
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE search5 USING fts5(content)
INSERT INTO search5(rowid,content) VALUES(1,'modern sqlite search'),(2,'other document')
SELECT rowid,highlight(search5,0,'[',']') FROM search5 WHERE search5 MATCH 'sqlite' ORDER BY rowid

cases.name: rtree-geopoly
statements: CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE spatial USING rtree(id,minx,maxx,miny,maxy)
INSERT INTO spatial VALUES(1,0,2,0,2),(2,10,12,10,12)
SELECT id FROM spatial WHERE minx<=1 AND maxx>=1 AND miny<=1 AND maxy>=1 ORDER BY id
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE polygons USING geopoly
INSERT INTO polygons(rowid,_shape) VALUES(1,'[[0,0],[2,0],[2,2],[0,2],[0,0]]')
SELECT rowid,abs(geopoly_area(_shape)) FROM polygons ORDER BY rowid

cases.name: inspection-math-stat4
statements: CREATE TABLE inspected(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,v INTEGER)
WITH RECURSIVE numbers(v) AS (VALUES(1) UNION ALL SELECT v+1 FROM numbers WHERE v<100) INSERT INTO inspected SELECT v,v%9 FROM numbers
CREATE INDEX inspected_v ON inspected(v)
ANALYZE
SELECT count(*)>0 FROM sqlite_stat4 WHERE tbl='inspected'
SELECT count(*)>0 FROM dbstat WHERE name='inspected'
SELECT pgno,length(data),hex(substr(data,1,16)) FROM sqlite_dbpage WHERE pgno=1
SELECT count(*)>0 FROM sqlite_stmt
SELECT count(*)>0 FROM bytecode('SELECT 1') WHERE opcode='Integer'
SELECT sqrt(9),log2(8),round(sin(pi()/2),9)
